verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a code-execution sandbox, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents on-demand sandbox creation, one-off commands, and blocking or detached command execution. Nothing shows a built-in recurring schedule or cron trigger; detached mode and persistence are one-off or adjacent features, not recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
